dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: You want to open another chest? I'm afraid you've already claimed everything I have on hand.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: If you really want more treasure, I should be able to scrape a few things together... How about you give me a few hundred years? Don't worry, you can wait that long if you try — you just have to believe in yourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: I've recently come into possession of all sorts of material, and I can't wait to let it all out. The next time Alice decides to host a tea party, I'll make sure to share it with the others!
